mechanism: account_movement_ck refuses a movement dated before opened_date; the refusal reaches the adapter as a generic SOAP fault, is classified transient, and blocks the partition for ever
dataFix: opened_date moved forward one day and last_movement_date cleared in the same UPDATE - the watermark has to go or the same constraint refuses the correction itself
reversal: restore originalOpenedDate; the next redelivery then succeeds and the partition drains
